moltenvk.name: MoltenVK 1.4.2
moltenvk.note: pin the sha before the first real build; Highball may substitute its own patched build as a component

toolchain.mingw: mingw-w64 (gcc) via Homebrew; llvm-mingw is known to break Steam's login (frankea, 2026-08-04)

x87sidecar.note: athei's x87sidecar, built from source for the Wine 11 engines; Wine's side (cooperative attach, ROSETTA_X87_PATH) is patches/0012 since r12.

wineopenxr.name: Proton's wineopenxr (LGPL)
wineopenxr.note: Copied into dlls/wineopenxr before the patch series; patches/0035 registers it and adapts it to macOS. Same commit as the Proton tree the 0031-0034 Wine changes come from (proton_11.0).

openxr_loader.name: Khronos OpenXR-SDK loader, release-1.1.36 (Apache-2.0)
openxr_loader.note: Built as a static library and linked into wineopenxr.so, the version Proton pins. It finds the native runtime (OXRSys) through XR_RUNTIME_JSON or ~/.config/openxr/1/active_runtime.json.
